comment: World / inventory art not covered by per-species data/plants/*/atlas.json. spriteSheet groups rows for merged SVG + atlas.json authoring (one sheet id = one target atlas). Omitted: squirrel cache (invisible), beehive (bee VFX + audio on host tree/log, no hive sprite). Food shares crafting_intermediates sheet with other intermediates.

actors.label: Actors
actors.atlasAuthoringHint: Merged SVG + atlas.json (format SVG) beside plant pipeline; see data/plants/juglans_nigra/atlas.json.

camp.label: Camp and stations
camp.description: Wigwam, drying rack, workbench, and other camp stations.
camp.atlasAuthoringHint: One merged sheet per category; frame spriteId stable e.g. station_drying_rack.

placeables.label: Placeables and tile features
placeables.description: Traps, weir/leaching tile art, on-tree tap/vessel.
placeables.atlasAuthoringHint: World/tile sprites; may pair with tools sheet for inventory icons of same item.

tools.label: Tool icons
tools.description: Inventory icons and ground-rescale drops for tools (including waterskin empty/full).
tools.atlasAuthoringHint: Grid cells for tool:* item icons; suggestedAtlasSpriteId in report uses item id slug.

crafting_intermediates.label: Crafting intermediates and food
crafting_intermediates.description: Non-tool, non-plant-part inventory icons: cordage, pemmican, bark, etc. Food lives here too.
crafting_intermediates.atlasAuthoringHint: One atlas for all intermediate + food icons; suggestedAtlasSpriteId from item id.

animal_parts.label: Animal carcasses and body parts (per species)
animal_parts.description: Inventory and world icons for `speciesId:partId` items; atlas `spriteId` = speciesId_partId.
animal_parts.atlasAuthoringHint: Merged SVG + format SVG `atlas.json` like other sprite sheets; frame `spriteId` = species + underscore + part (colons in item id become one underscore before part).
